text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you have a moment? I'd love to get 
your opinion.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make an accessory out of the 
stone you gave me, but... I can't decide 
on the base color.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Gold is great if you want to look 
glamorous. Though if you're thinking about 
everyday use, silver has a nice, 
subdued...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Silver... As in silver medal... 
............Gah, second place...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I shall go with gold after 
all. My apologies for keeping you. 
Ho-ho-ho...
